newsitem.title: SPAIN: Pernod Ricard to purchase Larios - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Pernod Ricard to purchase Larios - newspaper.

text.p: The French group Pernod Ricard is finalising the purchase of Malaga-based Larios, the Spanish market leader in gin, according to financial daily "Expansion."
The newspaper said the two could sign a definitive agreement this week.
The French group would be interested in the majority of the capital of Larios and would be ready to buy the entire group, although without Larios' stakes in other companies, it said.
In 1995, the gross sales of Larios reached 25.56 billion pesetas, with net consolidated earnings of 3.69 billion pesetas.
Larios has a 58 percent market share in gin.
